WoW's Anniversary (or in-lore as the Bronze Celebration) is an event celebrated around the 23rd of November that marks the release of the original World of Warcraft in 2004 and coincides with Warcraft's Anniversary which takes place around the 15th of November. Logging in during the anniversary typically rewards a special achievement and gives a unique buff to experience and reputation earned for the duration of the event. Every 5th and 10th anniversary year, the event is commemorated with a unique in-game event; the 10th anniversary included a level 100 version of Molten Core, and the 15th anniversary included a set of miniature raid wings that players had to survive through called the Memo

WoWthing is a World of Warcraft fan site whose purpose is to assist players (especially altoholics) with tracking and managing various things across all characters on their account(s), such as gear, professions, instance lockouts, and much more. This is accomplished by downloading its addon on CurseForge, [https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/wowthing-collector WoWthing Collector], and proceeding to upload the data to the website. There is also a very simple and light Windows-only desktop application, [https://github.com/ThingEngineering/wowthing-sync/releases WoWthing Sync], that automates uploading should one tire of manually doing so on WoWthing's upload webpage.

The WoW Secret Finding Discord is a community Discord server dedicated to World of Warcraft and Hearthstone secrets. It is a member of Blizzard's Community Discords Program. Due to the difficulty of maintaining current information for fast-moving topics in Discord pins, and software limits that cap the number of participants in a Thread, that community often relies on external tools to aggregate information, such as wikis or Google Docs.

The WoW Ambassador Program is a community initiative introduced by Blizzard Entertainment in January 2026 through the State of Azeroth that is meant to support new and returning players through partnered Discord communities. The program opened up for sign-ups on 29 January 2026, with the WoW Portal Room Discord server launching in February 2026.

World of Warcraft: 20 Years of Music was a concert series hosted by Helvepic with partnership from Blizzard Entertainment, celebrating the 20th anniversary of World of Warcraft with the soundtracks throughout its history. One was held on 27 September 2024, two more on 28 September 2024, and a last one on 29 September 2024 at the in with close to 200 swiss musicians, including around 100 singers from the epic music choir Tale of Fantasy as well as guest choirs Madrijazz Gospel and Ardito, accompanied by the 21st Century Orchestra, to perform a 2-hour live musical adventure, going through the history of the game and its expansions. It was broadcasted after the Warcraft 30th Anniversary Direct

World of Warcraft: Classic 20th Anniversary Edition is a server option for World of Warcraft: Classic. Anniversary introduced fresh realms based on the original 2019 debut of Classic, along with some new quality-of-life improvements. Anniversary realms launched on 21 November 2024 in celebration of World of Warcraft's 20th anniversary, and are confirmed to progress to in 2026. Hardcore Anniversary servers were also launched at the same time. The 20th Anniversary Edition was designed to offer a streamlined entry point for new and returning players, combining the original Classic experience with modern infrastructure and select quality-of-life updates. World of Warcraft: Forever (referred to by members of the community as Classic+ and internally during development as Camelot) is an upcoming massively multiplayer online roleplaying game (MMORPG) developed and published by Blizzard Entertainment. It was announced at BlizzCon 2026 and will release on 4 November 2026. This flavor of World of Warcraft is an alternative version that retains the core mechanics and aesthetic of the game's original 2004 release. However, it distinguishes itself by introducing new storylines, features, and content entirely distinct from the original historical timeline. World of Warcraft: Worldsoul Saga is a multi-expansion narrative storyline announced at BlizzCon 2023, designed to celebrate the first 20 years of World of Warcraft and establish new foundations for Azeroth's future. The saga spans three successive expansions: The War Within (2024), Midnight (2026), and The Last Titan (2027). The Worldsoul Saga marks a shift toward long-form storytelling in World of Warcraft, with interconnected plotlines, returning legacy characters, and deeper exploration of Azeroth's cosmic origins. The Wormlands is a large cavern located west of the Weaver's Lair in northwestern Azj-Kahet. The area is inhabited by cave borers that can sense movement above them. This is represented by the Tremorsense bar, which fills up when moving on soft ground and depletes when standing still or walking on rocks. When the bar is nearly full, a Razormouth Devourer will attack. Greenspeaker Na'layro, who stands just outside the Wormlands entrance tunnel, tasked adventurers with culling some of the worms.
